id: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (2019)

facts.text: Keep up, team. Snacks are in the X-wing and the night's just starting.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. The group flies to Pasaana in the Millennium Falcon, not an X-wing, so the snacks would be on the Falcon.
facts.fix: Keep up, team. The snacks are on the Falcon and the night's just starting.

fix_note.text: Keep up, team. The snacks are on the Falcon and the night's just starting.

facts.text: Serve the snacks during the festival on Pasaana.
facts.why: Wikipedia confirms the group goes to Pasaana to find a clue and meets Lando there. The plot summary does not mention a festival, so the festival and its name are unconfirmed in the sources opened.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when the group lands on Pasaana.

vibe.verdict: The invite format is generic for a film this big, but the dishes name real places like Kijimi, Kef Bir and the Lars homestead.
missing: Babu Frik rebuilding C-3PO's memory on Kijimi

Ben Solo discarding his lightsaber after the vision of Han
Lando bringing the galaxy's ships to Exegol
Rey burying the two lightsabers and taking the name Skywalker
ideas: Swap 'Pomegranate and mint sharbat' note for 'Lando's last drink before he brings the whole galaxy'.
Rename 'Twin suns pavlova' to 'Rey Skywalker pavlova' with the Tatooine closing line.
Swap 'Seated near: Exegol and the Sith fleet' for 'Seated near: Babu Frik' to keep it funny not grim.
Swap 'Exegol black pepper rib eye' note for 'Palpatine's fleet, served rare'.
